# /crav1-help

lane: cross-cutting | group: Start | starter: no | stage: stable | since: 1.52.0 | prompts: 1
purpose: Answer questions about the kit from its own local docs, with the source file and anchor for every answer.
use_when: You want to know what to run next, in what order, or what a skill does
reads: Reads `docs/reference/workflow.yaml`, `docs/reference/skills.yaml`, the reference pages, walkthroughs, concept pages, guild routing, and `CHANGELOG.md` from the kit repo (the full history at the repo root) or the `crav1-docs/` folder bundled next to the skills (the newest 15 releases); for a route or a status, the slice's `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, `verify.md`, and `work-item.md`; when online, the kit's tag names only. For `todo`, every spec in scope, its `tasks.md`, and the notes indexes; a pull request online only after a yes.
writes: Writes an answer in the chat that ends with its source file and anchor, and at most one newer-version line per chat.
leaves alone: Leaves every file alone.
limits: does not answer from memory, from general knowledge, or from GitHub. When the docs do not cover a question it says "the kit doesn't say". On pushback it re-reads the cited file and changes the answer only when the file says otherwise. When `crav1-docs/` is missing (only skill folders were copied), it answers from the skill files only and says so.
flow:
- `todo` items are three lines, the item, a plain label, then the command alone in its code span, with no `Next: <skill>`.
- `status` adds the one-line `/crav1-build-tasks <T#>` hint that the ready check no longer prints.
- `status` takes its Run next from the ready check (`walk_progress.py readiness --skip-sync --text --vendor copilot`, no build map written), so help and the ready check recommend the same command.
- No `Next:` line.
- Called with nothing, **`/crav1-help`** shows a usage guide with example questions.
- With `next` or a situation, it picks the route in `docs/reference/workflow.yaml` and lists the steps in order, marked done, next, skipped, or to do from the slice's file state (open questions, `plan.md`, ticked tasks, `verify.md`, `work-item.md`).
- It also explains a concept from the glossary and concept pages, lists skills by lane (`list`, `list <lane>`), gives the status of one slice (`status <slug>`, `where am I`) with the readiness rules of `/crav1-tasks-ready-to-build` and the route step it is on, compares two skills (`compare A B`), and summarizes the changelog for the installed version (`whats-new`, `whats-new since x.y`).
- Every answer ends with `Source: <file>#<anchor>`.
- It reads the kit repo's `docs/`, or the `crav1-docs/` folder bundled next to the skills (plugin, Cursor drop-in, Claude Code drop-in), never GitHub.
- The bundled `CHANGELOG.md` is the newest 15 releases and ends with a line to the full file.
- The kit repo root `CHANGELOG.md` is the full history.
- `whats-new` reads the installed version's section from the file for that install and does not fetch an older section.
- `status <slug>` and `where am I` add the Branches line and route unmerged work to `/crav1-open-pr` or `/crav1-merge-pr`.
- remote copy ages count whole calendar days in local time; a commit made today is `today`, not `1 day old`.
- status adds the `Sub-branches:` and `left behind:` lines and `merged, reverted on <base> (<sha>)`, report only.
- status adds the `Promotion:` line from `docs/environments/promotion.md` (branch reach, release and tag patterns, `not back on <base>`), with the optional `pipeline-runs` check.
- `todo`, `todo-next` (top 5) and `todo-top N`, with an optional scope (person, spec, topic, branch, or pull request), rank what to do next from the records.
- A **Yours first** group comes from `git config user.name` or `todo for <name>`.

## Choice words
- question: Also check the latest pipeline runs?
  - `pipeline-runs`: check the latest successful Azure DevOps runs behind the Promotion line (read-only)
- question: What to do next (optional, never asked)
  - `todo`: every action from the records, ranked (read-only)
  - `todo-next`: the top 5
  - `todo-top N`: the top N
called_by: Called by the user, or by an agent before it suggests more than one next step or when an order is questioned (the `crav1.mdc` rule).
runs by itself: Calls no skill.
you run next: The skill or route step it names
first: `/crav1-help I have new information from a meeting and tasks that are not built. What do I run, in order?`
walkthrough: from-help.md
human: https://github.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/blob/v1.208.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-help.md
